description: Headless, unstyled Vue 3 components (@vunset/vue), a pre-styled UI built on them (@vunset/ui), and a Nuxt module (@vunset/nuxt).
rules: A @vunset/vue component is a root plus parts: DialogRoot holds the state and its parts (DialogTrigger, DialogPopup) render inside it.
Style parts through the attributes they set, data-part and one data-* per state (data-open, data-checked, data-disabled); there are no size, variant or color props.
Every part takes `as` for the element it renders: a tag name or a component.
@vunset/ui needs `import '@vunset/ui/all.css'` once; its components are App* or Form* and are themed with CSS variables.
Charts and data tables import from @vunset/vue/chart and @vunset/vue/data-table, which need @tanstack/charts and @tanstack/vue-table installed.
